title: The Local Government Bill, 2019
summary: Sample extraction of the bill that establishes local government structures, decentralised functions, council proceedings, fee powers, and ward development committees.
memorandumPoints: Decentralisation of functions, responsibilities, and services
Democratic participation and control at local level
Revision of functions of local authorities
Review of tariffs, charges, and fees
Proceedings of the council and committees
Role of traditional leadership in democratic governance
Repeal and replacement of the Local Government Act, 1991
arrangementHighlights: Functions of local authority and standing orders
Finance, budgets, and financial year controls

sampleClauses.heading: Objects of the Bill
sampleClauses.triggerCondition: A council service, tariff, or committee process is configured
sampleClauses.controlIntent: Confirm the service or process is grounded in a local government power or function.

sampleClauses.heading: Functions of local authority
sampleClauses.triggerCondition: A new council workflow, permit, or service is created
sampleClauses.controlIntent: Map each application, permit, or service to an approved local authority function.

sampleClauses.heading: Standing orders
sampleClauses.triggerCondition: Council meeting workflow is published or updated
sampleClauses.controlIntent: Ensure council and committee proceedings follow approved standing orders.

sampleClauses.heading: Budget
sampleClauses.triggerCondition: Annual budget or supplementary budget is prepared
sampleClauses.controlIntent: Confirm the local authority budget is processed through the correct approval chain.
